name: The Ticket to Reality
source: You fall asleep on an Almaty Metro train, only to wake up and realize you’ve crossed into another dimension. Will you be able to return to reality — and can you save one or more of your fellow passengers along the way?
translation: 你在阿拉木圖的一列地鐵上睡著了，醒來才發現自己已經進入了另一個維度。你能回到現實嗎？一路上，你又能救下幾位同車的乘客，哪怕只有一位？
